Confirmed target mixes for the Elite Index Plus High Growth (85% equity/15% fixed income) and Elite Core Plus High Growth (85% equity/10% fixed income/5% alternatives) Unified Portfolios also carry forward unchanged. New today: the IA Clarington International Multifactor Equity Fund's Active ETF Series (TSX: IIME) had its confirmed TSX market-open ceremony on Sep 18/26 — a concrete recent-launch talking point for the broader iA Clarington product shelf that sits alongside Elite. On the fixed-income sub-advisor side, PIMCO's public commentary continues to trail the actual rate path (see signals above) — a talking point for wholesalers fielding advisor questions about the Elite fixed-income sleeve's PIMCO exposure. A minor, low-confidence Loomis Sayles '2026 Outlook for Emerging Market Debt' LinkedIn post surfaced today with no further retrievable detail. Governance news remains anchored by two items: the standing Mc Mahon reassignment (33 funds moved to iAGAM's Tej Rai/Alex Bellefleur) and the QV Canadian Small Cap PM transition (Amit Shah succeeding Steven Kim, effective Jul 3/26) — no newer PM or sub-advisor change surfaced today, and the Wealth Professional headline on the Mc Mahon story remains unverified in full text for a fourth day. The Ontario Advisor Lunch & Learn tour and the confirmed Montreal advisor conference (Sep 30-Oct 1/26, Marriott Château Champlain, now just 2-3 days out) remain the most likely near-term catalyst for genuine new Elite Pools allocation commentary. iA Clarington's overall AUM (>$26B) was reconfirmed again today, with a minor, unresolved internal-dating inconsistency (Jul 31/26 vs. Aug 31/26) across the firm's own source materials for that same figure.
